defects: The canopy still occupies most of the settlement-distance silhouette.
The tool wall and small salvage parts remain difficult to read at 64 inches.
The human-room overview does not support a claim of visible room-wide improvement.
hard_fail_reasons: At settlement scale the roof continues to dominate and the tool wall/small salvage remain hard to read, below the target's clear working-front requirement.
incumbent_comparison: v002 is a better gameplay-distance transfer than v001: the opening and appliance panels read more clearly at the identical 64-inch camera. Both still occupy too little of the human-room overview to demonstrate a room-wide change.
next_action_hypothesis: For the final Visual Director attempt, test a rear-set high canopy with a visibly braced edge, then compare it against v002 at the same settlement camera; keep the human-room conclusion limited to captured evidence.

observations.art_direction_fit: The salvage silhouette is stronger than v001 because the bench and mismatched doors show through the opening; the target's useful tool wall is still under-read.
observations.close_up_quality: The close production image shows the open bay and major construction, but does not yet carry the target's strong legibility for the tool wall and small joins.
observations.gameplay_readability: Luna scored v002 3/5, up from 2/5 for v001: the front bay and appliance panels are easier to distinguish at 64 inches, while the roof still dominates.
observations.geometric_detail: The close view shows the bench, drawers, appliance doors, roof seams and frame; Luna found that tools and small salvage details remain difficult to read at settlement scale.
observations.material_realism: Baked enamel, galvanized sheet, canvas and wood surfaces remain distinct in the close capture, but their smaller wear detail compresses at the gameplay camera.
observations.proportion: The model keeps the v001 envelope at 25.9 by 18.7 by 19.4 inches, but the roof remains visually broad relative to its work bay.
observations.scale_fidelity: The production resolver preserves the 26 by 20 by 20 inch presentation envelope; the human-room overview is too wide to support a room-wide improvement claim.
observations.semantic_recognizability: In the 64-inch production capture the cream/blue salvaged doors and timber canopy read as a Scavenger repair workshop, distinct from the Clockwork steam-room structures.
observations.silhouette_quality: The shorter high front edge opens the silhouette; the roof still owns most of its visible mass and the wall/tool details remain small.
observations.surface_variation: The close image retains grain and enamel wear, while the settlement view mostly keeps large roof and panel color areas.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 validated the imported GLB and rendered the exact v002 resource through the review-only resolver in the Scavenger production presentation.

close_inspection.evidence: The close capture shows the major assembly, but the smaller work tools and panel connections still need stronger evidence and do not transfer clearly to the gameplay camera.

edge_treatment.evidence: The close capture shows eased appliance corners, rolled roof edges, and softened timber and drawer edges.

hardware.evidence: The settlement image shows the appliance panels but loses most small fasteners, hinges and tool fittings at this viewing distance.

joins.evidence: The shortened eave now lands on a front bearer above the posts, and the three-quarter view exposes the frame supports below it.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: The workbench is easier to see, but the tool wall and minor household salvage still do not read clearly at the settlement distance.

material_response.evidence: The close view separates worn wood, cream/teal enamel, and galvanized roofing under production lighting.

surface_variation.evidence: Baked color, normal and roughness images contribute separate grain and worn-paint response in the close render.

thickness.evidence: Sheet corrugations, drawer faces and timber members show layered thickness in the close production render.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: At the settlement camera the broad repeated roof plane and compressed fittings still read as a stylized game model rather than the target's crafted miniature workshop.

photo_character.evidence: The approved ArtBrief has no photographic source requirement or reference image.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: Test a materially different rear-set canopy arrangement that leaves the foreground work bay open to the 64-inch view, with the edge landing on a clear bearer and braces.

panel fasteners and handles at the 64-inch camera
